---

**Type of Request**
- [ ] Feature Improvement (modify or optimize an existing element)
- [ ] New Feature (add a completely new section or functionality)

**Is your request related to a problem?**
A clear and concise description of what the problem is or what is currently lacking. (e.g. *I'm frustrated when...* or *This section is hard to navigate because...*)

**Describe the solution / feature you'd like**
A clear and detailed description of what you want to happen or see added to the website.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
A clear description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered (if any).

**Target Area / Page**
Mention the specific page, URL, or component affected (e.g. *HomePage*, *Navigation Bar*, *Wiki Section*).

**Additional context or screenshots**
Add any other context, mockup drawings, or screenshots about the feature request here.
